# ICP-001: Engineering Team at Scaling Series A-C SaaS

## Headline definition
VP of Engineering at Series B-C B2B SaaS companies (50-200 engineers) struggling with on-call rotation scaling pain.

## Firmographic frame
- Company stage: Series B-C SaaS.
- Employees: 50-200.
- Industry: B2B SaaS.
- Geography: US, UK, Western Europe.
- Buying authority: VP of Engineering (decision-maker), CTO (approver), Engineering Manager (champion).

## Decision cards

### [DEC-020] ICP-001 definition

**Decision:** Primary ICP is VP of Engineering at Series B-C SaaS (50-200 engineers) with on-call rotation scaling pain. Trigger event: hired 3rd Senior Engineer for on-call rotation in last 90 days.

**Why this:**
1. 35 interviews show consistent pattern: "on-call wakes me up 7+ times/month" is the trigger.
2. Series B-C employee count is the sweet spot — earlier is too small, later has internal tooling.

**Why not the alternatives:**
- Earlier-stage (Series A 5-50): too small, no on-call pain yet.
- Later-stage (Series D+ 200+): often has internal solution.
- Adjacent: SRE-led companies; rejected because SRE has different buying authority than VPE.

**Confidence:** High
**Evidence grade:** A (35 JTBD interviews; primary source).
**Source basis:** Research-backed.

**Commercial-bias flag:** None.

**Asset / channel / metric bindings:**
- Channel implications: LinkedIn (VPEs are active here), HackerNews (technical credibility), founder X.
- KPIs: trial signups from ICP-001-matching companies; D30 retention by ICP cohort.

**Kill criterion:** 6 months sustained <20 trial signups from ICP-001 segment despite targeted outreach.
**Reversal trigger:** VOC reveals dramatic ICP shift (e.g., DevOps-led purchase pattern).
**Test window:** 6-12 months (compound — ICP definition is foundational).

**Anti-pattern to avoid:** Targeting "all SaaS companies" (too generic, no JTBD specificity).

**Cross-cites consumed:** DEC-001 (business model), DEC-008 (positioning).
**Cross-cites produced:** consumed by website-copy subskill, paid-search subskill, cold-email subskill, content-strategy subskill, awareness-stages (DEC-040), messaging-architecture (DEC-110).

## Channel signals (consumed by channel-strategy)
- Primary: LinkedIn organic (founder + employee), HackerNews Show HN, paid search competitor terms.
- Supporting: founder content on X, newsletter sponsorship in The Pragmatic Engineer.
- Skip: TikTok, Meta Ads (audience density too low).

## What we are intentionally NOT doing
- Adding SRE-led companies as ICP-001 (different buying authority).
- Including pre-Series-A startups (too small for our pricing).
